overview.name: Corgi IREN 2x Daily ETF
overview.description: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that, under ordinary market conditions, seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of IREN Limited ("IREN"). It is non-diversified.
